# Move between directories and see where you landed

> Zoxide jumps, the bare-word fallback, and the listing that follows every move.

Every entry links to where the guide explains it.

| | what it does | where | guide |
|---|---|---|---|
| `z <query>` | Jump to a directory by a fragment of its path | shell | [Move between directories, and make new ones](../guide/directories.md#z-query) |
| `zi / cdi` | Pick a directory from zoxide interactively | shell | [Move between directories, and make new ones](../guide/directories.md#zi-cdi) |
| `zz` | Toggle back to the directory you came from | shell | [Move between directories, and make new ones](../guide/directories.md#zz) |
| `zl <query>` | Jump to a directory and list it | shell | [Move between directories, and make new ones](../guide/directories.md#zl-query) |
| `zc <query>` | Jump to a directory and start Claude there | shell | [Move between directories, and make new ones](../guide/directories.md#zc-query) |
| `<word>` | Jump by typing a directory name on its own | shell | [Move between directories, and make new ones](../guide/directories.md#word) |
| `cd <path>` | Enter a directory, creating it if it does not exist | shell | [Move between directories, and make new ones](../guide/directories.md#cd-path) |
| `mkcd` | Understand the one funnel every move goes through | shell | [Move between directories, and make new ones](../guide/directories.md#mkcd) |
| `ls` | List a directory as structured, decorated data | shell | [See what is in a directory](../guide/listing.md#ls) |
| `ls -D` | List with real recursive directory sizes | shell | [See what is in a directory](../guide/listing.md#ls-d) |
| `l / ll / la` | List short, long, or including dotfiles | shell | [See what is in a directory](../guide/listing.md#l-ll-la) |
| `y` | Open the yazi file manager | shell | [See what is in a directory](../guide/listing.md#y) |
